# Pip Pop

> Pip Pop (https://pippop.pet) is a free 3D toy-box game that plays in the browser. It is a skin of the Structs blockchain strategy game: every player is a real Structs player, and every action is a real Structs transaction. It is a satire for grown-ups dressed as a baby toy, not a game for children.

## How it plays
- Open a gift to meet your Bear, the boss toy (a Structs Command Ship).
- Your play mat (a Structs planet) holds toys on four levels: Moon, Sky, Grass and Tub (space, air, land, water).
- A Digger digs rocks (ore); a Popper pops rocks into stars (alpha matter). Rocks can be grabbed by others; stars cannot.
- Fill stars into your club's Fridge (a guild reactor) for juice (energy). Juice lets you make more toys.
- Roll your wagon (fleet) to another pet's mat, bonk their Bear until it goes poof, and grab their rocks (a raid).
- Wind (charge) builds up every tick; each action needs enough of it.

## Links
- Play: https://pippop.pet/
- Structs, the game underneath: https://playstructs.com
- Structs technical documentation: https://structs.ai
